statement: The Lord-Shulman relaxation carries a stored-energy density tau_q q.q/(2 kappa T0) which is NON-ZERO in cycle average, while the functional tau_q q.qdot/kappa has ZERO cycle average; the vanishing of one is therefore not evidence about the other
test_function: symbolic cycle average in theory note; executed in code/foundation_checks.py derivation script
input_fixture: monochromatic q(t) = Re[Q exp(i w t)], symbolic and integrated over one period
actual_output: <q.qdot> = 0 exactly; <q.q> = |Q|^2/2 exactly; <Delta psi> = tau_q|Q|^2/(4 kappa T0) > 0
notes: RESOLVES the question carried OPEN since Phase 1 (BLK-LS-STORAGE) at the MATHEMATICAL level. Proposition prop:relax is proved by direct period integration: <q.qdot> = (i w/4)(Q.Q* - Q*.Q) = 0 because the two terms are complex conjugates, whereas <q.q> = |Q|^2/2. The EIT free energy Psi_EIT = Psi + tau_q q.q/(2 kappa T0) therefore does contribute a genuine stored-energy density, even though its cycle-averaged time derivative vanishes. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE GATE: the relaxation does not enter <J_z> or <D>, so the cycle-averaged balance is unaffected; it DOES enter the energy DENSITY and hence any definition of absorbed energy based on a stored-energy change. The remaining open item is therefore PHYSICAL (which functional an experiment measures) and requires a scattering solution; it is NOT the mathematical confusion that BLK-LS-STORAGE recorded.
